Power training designed around 2 sessions per week for intermediate climbers

This 6-week program is designed for intermediate level climbers between the grades of V5 - V8 (6C+ - 7B) or 5.11c - 5.12d (6c+ - 7c) and for climbers new to power training.  It is recommend climbers following this program spread the training across 2 days per week.
